reviews.text: Very friendly and patient with my anxious senior dog
Love Katrina!! We followed her here and drive the extra miles because she’s the best! Our little special Chihuahua mix Murphy just really loves her and she takes great care of his needs!

I brought my newly adopted dog Ollie here for the first time and was so impressed at not just the service, but the emphasis on making Ollie feel comfortable. Rainer took his time meeting Ollie and asking important questions about his habits. My dog is an anxious/fearful little guy so the fact that he was able to get through a full grooming service with no issues solidified my decision to return. Thanks Rainer!

The team at Philly Floof did a wonderful job caring my sweet, anxious pup, Rob. They went above and beyond to make sure Rob (and I) were comfortable and they keep me updated throughout his appointment. It was so sweet and considerate and I appreciated their extra care! Plus my dog looked and smelled amazing after his bath and grooming! We will absolutely be going back and I would highly recommend this business and their incredible team!

This is my first time using Philly Floof Grooming. I have a 7 pound Maltese and an 11 pound Maltipoo. They did a great job providing a full service groom for both my dogs. I sent over a picture of what I wanted for them to look like and Philly Floof delivered. They were both crated together, which I thought was great at pick up. My previous groomer let all the dogs roam freely in their salon and I think it caused much unnecessary anxiety for my dogs. Easy appointment setup. Easy pick up. They accept cash and credit. Price is reasonable for the area. I highly recommend. Will definitely be coming back here for my pet grooming needs. Also love that they’re a local business in the Fairmount section of Philly.
I just moved to Philly not too long ago and Philly floof did such a good job cutting my Yuzu. He came back soo soft and clean. I’m literally so obsessed with his cut. I highly recommend!!
We had our dogs groomed here for the first time today.  They have never looked better.  And they are 10.  And we have lived in four states.

We love Katrina at Phillyfloof.. we even followed her there and I know others have as well. She takes care of our little senior dog Murphy so well and you can tell she enjoys your job! Its way more affordable as well than the other places we have been to.
Great experience, every time. Friendly staff and my dog always looks so happy afterwards!

Followed Katrina here! She does an amazing job with both my doodle and my shiba inu! Breyer was slightly nervous just cuz it was a new place but when I showed up for pickup I could see Katrina sitting in the pen petting him! I’ll never go elsewhere for my pups because I know they are loved and I will always get the absolute best service!

My dog looks so BEAUTIFUL after her groom!! The woman who groomed her was quite possibly the nicest person I've ever met in my life, and I truly believe she was SO kind to my (very nervous) dog throughout the whole process. They are clearly so knowledgeable and talented.

I do just want to let future clients know that they are not crate/cage-free; I found out after my appointment that they use both crates/cages and pens. Before coming here I read several reviews on Yelp/Google/social media stating that they were crate/cage free, and because of this I didn't think to ask for my dog to be put in a pen. When I came to pick my dog up she was in a cage. This is obviously my fault for believing the reviews and not checking with the owner firsthand, but I wanted to clear up some misinformation! I recommend that if you want your dog to be in one of their pens you tell the owner/groomer before the appointment!
So grateful for Phill floof. They do such a wonderful job and treat your dog with such love and care!

10/10 Experience!

We are so grateful for the amazing team at Philly Floof Grooming! Our dog Doc is usually very nervous about grooming, but they took such incredible time and care to make him comfortable throughout the whole process. You can really tell they love what they do and genuinely care about each pup who comes through their doors.

Doc’s haircut looks absolutely perfect — clean, even, and just adorable! We couldn’t be happier with how he looks and how relaxed he seemed afterward. Thank you, Philly Floof, for treating our anxious boy with such kindness and patience. We’ll definitely be back! 💕🐾
Always go and continue to have great experiences. Great communication. Always take care of my two pups. Thank you Philly floof!!
Amazing!  Jess and her team were amazing! Artemis does not allow anyone to trim her nails, Jess was super patient and took her time. I love that they are fear free. Wonderful experience!

They are insanely expensive, I chose this place because of the great reviews but I’m charged almost 100 bucks for my tiny dog’s grooming. I’ve never paid more than 70 and then they charge 15 dollars for every 30 minutes once they send you a text. I’m supposed to just be on my phone staring at it and rushing out the door the second I receive a notification just to avoid even more fees. I don’t even get to see my dog before they ask for a 15 percent tip minimum. I’m paying double than I normally do for what?! He’s cute but it was nothing so spectacular that it was worth it. Edit: they didn’t even cut parts of him evenly like his paws. I asked for his face to be round, it’s not. I asked for his ears to be short, they’re like double the size of his face. Didn’t even cut his nails properly which is pretty much the whole reason I get him groomed so regularly. Never ever going here again. Save your money and go somewhere that will actually do something. Another edit: OH MY GOD I found out they didn’t even cut all of nails, I thought they just didn’t cut them short enough, they just didn’t cut some of them. The owner reached out and offered to fix the damage but I work everyday and I’m a student who relies on others transportation to get there because I don’t have a drivers license. I am so dissatisfied and dissapointed because now I have to find another groomer to fix the mess of his nails and wait for all his baldness to grow out so I can get him properly groomed by people who aren’t going to just shave half his stomach and not trim his ears. Again, a hundred dollars for nothing, I want my money back at this point if they can’t even cut his nails.

I have been bringing my dog Bello here for his grooming for over a year now and have always been very happy with the service and staff who work on him. They take their time and work with me to keep him calm through the process. He can be a challenge with his anxieties to grooming. I am grateful to have found a great place I can count on for his grooming needs and my piece of mind in the process.

Simply amazing. They do an excellent job, I can tell Leon, my dog, is not stressed when I pick him up. The length and style are always great and never a cut or anything of the sort. Manuel is wonderful.
My golden retriever is usually fussy with groomers, but they handled him so well here. He came home looking fluffy and smelling great. Will be booking again soon.
Amazing cut! Have been taking our puppy there for about a year now and April gives a fantastic groom every time!
Jess is the absolute best and is so talented with grooming! She really takes extra time and care to make sure she does the job right.

They were amazing! We took our 3 year old golden retriever there to get trimmed up after having never been groomed before. They did a great job and he is so much lighter, cleaner, and far less scruffy looking. Owner was extremely nice and accommodating. They got him in for an appointment quickly.

My pitt is so picky when it comes to people he’ll allow to groom him, especially his hands and face, due to his past. It got to the point where the groomers at generic pet shops can no longer do those services. He’s got terrible separation anxiety and will scream in holding kennels when he can no longer get to me, so needless to say I’ve been reluctant and embarrassed to take him back to pet shops. This was my first time here and the AWESOME ladies at Philly Floof made him seem like a breeze! When one method didn’t work, they kept trying different ways until my pup was comfortable to get the work done. They even let me come back and distract him during nail clipping! Will definitely be a repeat client. Their pricing is awesome, parking was relatively easy and the space was extremely clean with cute decor! If you’re reluctant like me due to similar issues, rest assured they’re there to help!

Everyone here was so nice to my anxious dog! I felt so comfortable leaving her. I’ve been here twice now and both times I was very satisfied with the services.
Highly recommend

If you're thinking of a new place to go, go here!! You will not regret taking your dog here. My bf and I just adopted a dog and we were nervous on how he would do and she assured us that she would go slow on him. We are very happy about she groomed him and we couldn't be any happier. I def will be coming back!! Here's a before and after.
We were very nervous taking our kitty somewhere to be groomed for the first time, but had a wonderful experience!!! competitive pricing and treated Miso so well!!! We will be back!

Chewy is a tough little senior chihuahua who’s been rejected by other groomers, but not Philly Floof!! Jess somehow worked her magic to wash and groom anxious/evil little Chewy without incident. And, on a practical note, the online appointment scheduler is THE BEST. So easy!

Jess and her team were wonderful! The moment I walked in they were very inviting and sat down with me and my dog (Theia) to come up with a grooming plan. They took the time to get to know Theia so she could feel comfortable with them! I really appreciated that Jess and her team had dog houses for the dogs to go in while they waited, instead of dogs running all over the store. When I picked Theia up she looked absolutely stunning and smelled so good! I was so impressed how they groomed Theia and made her look beautiful. Austrian shepherds can be hard to groom and previously at other dog salons I have had terrible experiences with her being shaved down. Jess and her team trimmed her up so nice and made her pantaloons look so good! The place was so clean and well kept! Price was very reasonable to other places in the city. We will definitely be back!
They did an amazing job !!!!! My goldendoodle was sad to leave lol! His first grooming and he came out soooo cute

Took my anxious rescue here and Jess was absolutely amazing with her! Nail clipping took all of 5 minutes, Jess was kind and patient, and my pup was as at ease as I’ve seen her at a groomer. Will definitely be back!
Jess did an absolutely incredible job on my lil Pomeranian baby! Affordable, communicative and my pup looks & smells amazing! Thank you so much will absolutely be returning again and again!

Biscuit and I had a WONDERFUL experience at Philly Floof! Jess and her team did a fantastic job and also took the time to sit with us and let Biscuit get to know them first, which was super helpful since he’s nervous around new people. It’s always a bit nerve wracking trying a new groomer, but I knew from the moment we walked in that he was good hands! Their shop is so so clean and we’re so happy they’re in the neighborhood! We’ll be coming back for sure :) THANK YOU!

Met the owner before they opened when I was on a run. Took my pup Bodhi for the first time today and they were super nice and welcoming. They absolutely nailed the cut for Bodhi as well. He has never looked better. Super clean space and incredible staff. I just found my go-to groomer.

It's rare to immediately feel safe leaving your fur baby with someone else but that's how you feel when you walk into Philly Floof Grooming. It's a more personal experience and our dog Kieba, was calm and happy there for his whole spa day. 15/10 would recommend!

Could not have asked for a better experience! My wife and I took our Chow Chow, Sully, here for his first groom. They took the time to get to know him, talk to us about what we wanted, and even sent us update pictures throughout. We really …
